description: FOUND AND FIXED 2026-08-11 while wiring S(alpha,beta) temperature interpolation (op-1y4y/op-cjw.22 session; fix in working tree, not committed). DEFECT: src/endf/interp.rs terp1 attached the wrong formulas to ENDF INT codes 3 and 4: code 3 (LinLog) computed ln(y)-linear-in-x (which is ENDF law 4) and code 4 (LogLin) computed y-linear-in-ln(x) (which is ENDF law 3). Verified against ENDF-102 0.5.2 and upstream NJOY2016 endf.f90 terp1 (i=3: y=y1+log(x/x1)*(y2-y1)/log(x2/x1); i=4: y=y1*exp((x-x1)*log(y2/y1)/(x2-x1))). The unit tests only covered laws 1/2/5, which is how it slipped through. IMPACT: any TAB1 with INT=3 or INT=4 segments evaluated via terp1/eval_tab1 (reconr linearize, photon, nuclear_data/secondary, purr heating, groupr kinematics LEP) interpolated with the wrong law; most neutron XS tables are INT=2 so the blast radius is limited, but MF7 MT4 extra-temperature LISTs are LI=4 and would have been wrong. FIX: formulas swapped back to ENDF semantics, upstream-parity flat-segment short-circuit (y1==y2 -> y1) added, pinned unit tests for laws 3 and 4 added, reconr/linearize.rs midpoint_energy arm updated (geometric mean now for LinLog|LogLog) and its lin_log_adds_points test corrected to INT=4 (its comment always said 'linear in E but log in sigma'). 393 lib tests pass after the fix. REMAINING: human review; consider re-running any V&V gates for modules that consume INT=3/4 data (RECONR Doppler gates were green after the fix in this session's lib run).
title: njoy endf::interp::terp1 had ENDF laws 3/4 swapped - FIXED 2026-08-11, needs human review
